name: cascade_delete
description: In `app.delete('/api/customers/:c_custkey')`, the code explicitly deletes all orders with `Order.destroy({ where: { o_custkey } })` before deleting the customer. However, the `/api/orders` endpoint only returns orders tied to active customers via `WHERE o_custkey IN (SELECT c_custkey FROM customer)`, so child rows are not independently needed after parent deletion. This is a safe, intentional cascade with no observable data loss for other endpoints.
